title: PageSpec
description: A page composed from this design-repo. mode=reference reconstructs a real source route; mode=generated is a new page for someone else and may not carry source identity (enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py GENERATED_MODE_* rules). maxWords / x-assetRoles are enforced by the semantic validator. Generated from sections/*.json by the repo build; extraction/verify_all.py fails if any branch drifts from its contract.

tokens.description: Optional per-node token references; values must be catalog token ids allowed by tokens/llm/token-policy.json (never raw values).
